text: Bittern-2 enforces a rate limit of 4000 requests per minute per caller.
Unlike Pipit-3, whose datacenter is handled elsewhere, the datacenter of Curlew-9 is the Dublin datacenter. Nobody should assume the datacenter of Curlew-9 applies to Pipit-3, the datacenter differs.
Pages from Bittern-2 land on the pager rotation of Farah Quintero before anyone else. The entry was reformatted last quarter.

Unlike Bittern-2, whose pager rotation is handled elsewhere, the pager rotation of Siskin-4 is Umar Thorne. Nobody should assume the pager rotation of Siskin-4 applies to Bittern-2, the pager rotation differs.
Unlike Siskin-4, whose budget is handled elsewhere, the budget of Bittern-2 is $4875k. Nobody should assume the budget of Bittern-2 applies to Siskin-4, the budget differs.
The service Pipit-3 takes traffic on port 6135, and the port is fixed across every environment. An older draft of this note was archived.
Pages from Curlew-9 land on the pager rotation of Lucia Lindqvist before anyone else.
The service Bittern-2 takes traffic on port 9239, and the port is fixed across every environment.

Unlike Curlew-9, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Plover-4 is May 11, 2028. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Plover-4 applies to Curlew-9, the retirement date differs.
The retirement date for Pipit-3 is June 6, 2028; after that day it stops serving. The page was last reviewed in the spring.
The yearly budget for Pipit-3 is $2530k, covering licences and hosting.
Expect throttling at the rate limit for Tern-6, which is 150 requests per minute. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.

The service Plover-4 takes traffic on port 9657, and the port is fixed across every environment. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
The language of Pipit-3 is Elixir, which new contributors must know. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.

The owner of Plover-4 is the Compass team, and every change to Plover-4 goes through their review. An older draft of this note was archived.
Questions about Tern-6 start with its owner, the Lattice team; they triage anything filed against it.
Curlew-9 was granted a budget of $780k this year; an unspent budget does not roll over. The entry was reformatted last quarter.
The pager rotation for Plover-4 is run by Lucia Zielinski; alerts page them first.

Unlike Tern-6, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Siskin-4 is the Anvil team. Nobody should assume the owner of Siskin-4 applies to Tern-6, the owner differs. The entry was reformatted last quarter.

Tern-6 is implemented in Erlang; the language was chosen for its tooling.
